summary: Vistagen Therapeutics filed an 8-K (Items 8.01, 9.01) announcing preliminary positive data from an open-label extension of its PALISADE-3 Phase 3 study of fasedienol for social anxiety disorder. The press release highlights tolerability and exploratory efficacy over 12 months. This is a routine clinical data update, not a special situation. No deal terms, M&A activity, or corporate restructuring are involved. The registrant is the filer itself. No action or event changes corporate control or structure.
